durability: Tracked source, harness, deterministic vectors, independent auditor and exact result copies. Recovery lengths and SHA-256 are rechecked byte-for-byte.
falsification: Malformed field/type/path/key inputs and noncanonical/duplicate JSON reject. Omitted field closure and omitted key derivation each admit a record rejected by the independent parser. Altered qualification results fail the independent audit.
implementation: Pure inactive RuntimeRecord.pm serializes the pinned closed runtime schema. Explicit field count and membership precede value checks. JSON scalar types, canonical byte spelling, bounded parsing/encoding, independently derived workspace key and ordered isolated image paths are required. Decoder delegates to the same complete object validation before exact byte comparison.
limits: Synthetic historical device/inode and path values are data only. A structurally valid record is not fresh custody, content-key byte proof, current same-volume ownership, a global filename join or runtime authorization.
The exact record-limit vector deliberately uses a long syntactically valid workspace name; no filesystem compatibility is inferred and no such directory is created.
No runtime reference or fixture workspace is created, no process is launched by the harness, and product source is unchanged.

Acquisition must additionally check fresh ownership, image bytes, the global filename and both exact reference copies. Reference lifetimes, contention, maintenance, native behavior and historical startup repair remain open.
rederive: Independent Python JSON/set/type/path parser reconstructs canonical vectors, source framing and runtime keys, including an exactly full record and a native integer beyond binary64 exact precision. Complete TAP and encoded results are audited. Existing field-set RED/GREEN and publication evidence independently reverifies without another filesystem or native experiment.
